reason: The potato bay needs a lightproof skirt, and the foil and fabric look suitable for making one.
expectation: They will form a cover that can shield the potato tuber space from light.

effect: The foil-backed cloth blocks light and looks ready to become the potato bay's skirt.
reaction: The lamp test makes the material choice feel practical.
reason: The potato bay needs this lightproof covering, so I'll use it at the prepared beds.
expectation: The cloth will form a skirt around the potato tuber space.

effect: The potato bay is now shaded while leaving shoots exposed, so it is ready for planting.
reaction: The distinction between shaded tubers and lit shoots is useful.
reason: The prepared potato bay is the natural place for the seed potatoes.
expectation: The seed potatoes will be planted in the shaded bay.

effect: The potatoes are planted, leaving the soybean and lettuce goals.
reaction: The deeper medium and dark skirt make the planting arrangement clear.
reason: The prepared growing beds have a separate soybean row, so the seeds should go there.
expectation: The soybeans will be planted in their designated row.

effect: The soybean row is sown, leaving the lettuce planting goal.
reaction: The spaced pockets and aerated row make the planting clear.
reason: The prepared beds include a shallow lettuce tray, so I'll plant the remaining seeds there.
expectation: The lettuce seeds will be sown in their designated tray.

effect: The lettuce seeds have no available operation yet, so planting apparently needs another preparation.
reaction: That was unexpected given the prepared tray.
reason: I'll check the beds for an available preparation or planting operation.
expectation: The inspection should reveal which available item can be used at the beds.

effect: The inspection automatically used the fabric to prepare a wicking lettuce bed; the seeds should now have a suitable place.
reaction: The fabric wick explains the missing preparation, though it was not obvious from the initial tray description.
reason: The wicking bed is ready for the remaining lettuce seeds.
expectation: The lettuce seeds will be sown in the prepared bed.

effect: The lettuce is sown in the wicking tray, completing the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: The damp wick makes the final planting feel physically coherent.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making and installing the potato skirt was worthwhile: the light test and open top explained how the tubers stay dark while shoots receive light.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed lettuce attempt was confusing because the tray had been described as prepared, but still needed a wick.

surprise.text: I was surprised that inspecting the beds automatically installed fabric as a wick; the explanation showed how it could draw solution upward without another pump.

arbitrary.text: The need for fabric at the lettuce tray lacked a clear advance hint, even though the wick's purpose made sense afterward.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the crops develop; the potato skirt and lettuce wick offered useful, concrete details, despite the unclear prerequisite.
